result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection in a residential neighborhood with well-maintained sidewalks and high-visibility zebra crosswalks. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like signals and curb ramps are present, the crossing distance is moderate and sight lines are partially obscured by street trees and parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Street trees and parked vehicles near the intersection corners may limit the visibility between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbsides approaching the intersection

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the full width of the roadway without a median refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Main zebra crosswalk across the intersection

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.
